# penguin_tencentcloud_bandwidth_package_selection (Resource)

Select (once) the schedulable shared bandwidth package in a region (via `GET /tencentcloud/bandwidth-packages`) and persist the choice in Terraform state. Use `terraform taint` to force reselection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "penguin_tencentcloud_bandwidth_package_selection" "selected" {
  region       = "ap-guangzhou"
  network_type = "BGP"
  # Optional: omit for default auto-selection, use @tag for tagged auto-selection,
  # or provide an explicit bandwidth package ID.
  shared_bandwidth_package_id = "@schedulable"
}
```

`shared_bandwidth_package_id` is optional. When omitted, or when set to the empty string `""`, Penguin auto-selects from the default schedulable pool. Set it to `@tagName` to select from `tag:penguin=<tagName>`, or set it to an explicit bandwidth package ID for direct lookup. The provider rejects whitespace-only values and values with leading or trailing whitespace during `terraform plan`; a lone `@` is rejected by the Penguin API.
